Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Also, just out of curiosity, when creating the VERY needed 5 cap
>Tremere/!Tremere, why did they end up with the same exact disciplines?
> Couldn't one have been AUS dom THA and the other AUS DOM tha. I
>just get real annoied when the sabbat vampires are just carbon copies
>of the camarilla with different names.

I agree with some of the others how having both of the vampires AUS dom THA was
really good for both clans (Tremere and !Tremere). The Tremere clans really
could have used such reliable mid-caps. And while one "AUS dom THA" and one
something else decent would still have helped a lot, producing two "AUS dom
THA"'s provides an excellent, sturdy foundation for many Tremere decks.

One thing I am annoyed by however is that Aisling gets a special (however
useless) and Hannigan does not. I know it's probably b/c Aisling is a signature
character, but I don't see why this means White Wolf should play favorites...

Halcyan 2
